mapper.select: SELECT id,user_id,status,current_revision_no,ended_at,history_locked_through,version,created_at,updated_at,deleted_at FROM habit WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id}

SELECT h.id::text,h.status,h.current_revision_no AS revision_no,h.ended_at,h.history_locked_through,
h.version,h.created_at,h.updated_at,r.id::text AS revision_id,r.name,r.description,r.completion_criteria,
r.category_id::text,c.name AS category_name,(c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS category_deleted,
r.cycle_type,r.weekday_mask,r.start_date,r.expected_time,(ci.id IS NOT NULL) AS checked_today FROM habit h JOIN habit_revision r ON r.habit_id=h.id AND r.user_id=h.user_id AND r.revision_no=h.current_revision_no
LEFT JOIN habit_category c ON c.id=r.category_id AND c.user_id=h.user_id
LEFT JOIN habit_checkin ci ON ci.user_id=h.user_id AND ci.habit_id=h.id AND ci.business_date=#{today} AND ci.cancelled_at IS NULL WHERE h.user_id=#{userId} AND h.id=#{id} AND h.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT h.id::text,h.status,h.current_revision_no AS revision_no,h.ended_at,h.history_locked_through,
h.version,h.created_at,h.updated_at,r.id::text AS revision_id,r.name,r.description,r.completion_criteria,
r.category_id::text,c.name AS category_name,(c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS category_deleted,
r.cycle_type,r.weekday_mask,r.start_date,r.expected_time,(ci.id IS NOT NULL) AS checked_today FROM habit h JOIN habit_revision r ON r.habit_id=h.id AND r.user_id=h.user_id AND r.revision_no=h.current_revision_no
LEFT JOIN habit_category c ON c.id=r.category_id AND c.user_id=h.user_id
LEFT JOIN habit_checkin ci ON ci.user_id=h.user_id AND ci.habit_id=h.id AND ci.business_date=#{today} AND ci.cancelled_at IS NULL
ORDER BY h.created_at DESC,h.id DESC LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}

SELECT count(*) FROM habit h JOIN habit_revision r
ON r.habit_id=h.id AND r.user_id=h.user_id AND r.revision_no=h.current_revision_no
mapper.sql: WITH days AS ( SELECT (#{today}::date + n)::date AS business_date FROM generate_series(0, #{today}::date - #{today}::date) AS n ), habit_days AS ( SELECT d.business_date,h.id AS habit_id,h.status,h.deleted_at,h.history_locked_through, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.revision_id ELSE r.id END AS revision_id, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.category_id ELSE r.category_id END AS category_id, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.name ELSE r.name END AS name, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.expected_time ELSE r.expected_time END AS expected_time, c.id AS checkin_id, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS done_count, 1 AS due_count FROM habit h CROSS JOIN days d LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ci.id,ci.revision_id,cr.category_id,cr.name,cr.expected_time FROM habit_checkin ci JOIN habit_revision cr ON cr.id=ci.revision_id AND cr.habit_id=h.id AND cr.user_id=h.user_id WHERE ci.habit_id=h.id AND ci.user_id=h.user_id AND ci.business_date=d.business_date AND ci.cancelled_at IS NULL ) c ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT hr.id,hr.category_id,hr.name,hr.expected_time,hr.status_snapshot,hr.deleted_snapshot, hr.start_date,hr.weekday_mask FROM habit_revision hr WHERE hr.habit_id=h.id AND hr.user_id=h.user_id AND hr.effective_date<=d.business_date ORDER BY hr.effective_date DESC,hr.revision_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) r ON true WHERE h.user_id=#{userId} AND ( c.id IS NOT NULL OR (r.status_snapshot='ACTIVE' AND NOT r.deleted_snapshot AND r.start_date<=d.business_date AND (r.weekday_mask::integer & (1 << (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM d.business_date)::integer-1)))<>0) ) )
mapper.select:
SELECT habit_id::text,revision_id::text,category_id::text,name,expected_time,status,checkin_id::text,done_count,due_count,
(checkin_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (history_locked_through IS NULL OR history_locked_through<#{today})) AS can_cancel,
(checkin_id IS NULL AND status='ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (history_locked_through IS NULL OR history_locked_through<#{today})) AS can_checkin
FROM habit_days ORDER BY expected_time NULLS LAST,habit_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id,user_id,status,current_revision_no,ended_at,history_locked_through,version,created_at,updated_at,deleted_at FROM habit WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
AND status='ACTIVE' AND id>#{afterId} ORDER BY id LIMIT 100

UPDATE habit SET history_locked_through=#{through},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now}
WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND (history_locked_through IS NULL OR history_locked_through<#{through})
